message:
feat(diagnostics): live session data + real log folder (#403)

ShellDiagnosticsPort now reports negotiated protocolVersion, engine identity, last-used backend, and ADR-0002 worker status from a wired TranscriptionSession snapshot; cache/log paths come from the new diagnostics_paths command, ログフォルダを開く reveals the real logs dir, エンジンを再起動 delegates to the session, verovio reports the bundled version, and engine stderr is teed into logs/engine-<unix>.log (10-file retention).

Closes #403
